description: Lists the tight transits of a given day to a natal chart: aspects of the transiting Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn to the natal planets, Ascendant and MC within 2° (3° for Jupiter and Saturn), plus each planet's current sign and natal house and the Moon phase. Use it for questions like 'what are my transits today' or 'what is happening in my chart this week'. The date defaults to today in the person's time zone. Computed with the Swiss Ephemeris; no forecast text is generated. Birth data is used only for this calculation and is not stored or logged.

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Omit if unknown: then houses, Ascendant and MC are not computed.
birth_time.title: Birth Time

current_timezone.description: IANA time zone where the person is now (defines 'today'); defaults to the birth time zone.
current_timezone.title: Current Timezone

date.description: Day to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in current_timezone.
date.title: Date

house_system.description: House system: koch (default), placidus or whole_sign.
house_system.title: House System

lang.description: Language of the result: en or ru.
lang.title: Lang

place.description: Birth city, e.g. 'Chicago, Illinois, USA'. Used to look up coordinates and the time zone. Not needed if latitude/longitude are given.
place.title: Place

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place, e.g. America/Chicago. Looked up from the place/coordinates when omitted.
timezone.title: Timezone

name: transits_today
title: Transits to a natal chart
